welcome.title: Sudoku Hint Bot
welcome.subtitle: I can help you solve Sudoku puzzles by providing step-by-step hints!
welcome.instructions:
1. Upload a photo of your Sudoku puzzle
2. Confirm the recognized puzzle is correct
3. Ask for hints to solve it step by step

help.title: Help
help.commandNext: Show the next step in current hint
help.commandApply: Apply the hint to your puzzle
help.uploadAnytime: You can also upload a new puzzle image at any time.
